tools.name: search_parts_knowledge
tools.description:
Search 521 knowledge cards about fiber laser machine parts: laser sources, cutting heads,
    welding heads, control systems, wire feeders. Query by model (e.g. "BLT421", "FSCUT2000",
    "RFL-C3000"), alarm/error keyword, or topic. Optional brand filter: raycus / maxphotonics /
    jpt / bochu (fri

tools.name: get_part_card
tools.description:
Fetch ONE knowledge card in full (specs table, wiring, alarm codes, consumable part
    numbers, field notes) by card_id (from search results) or by exact/partial title.

tools.name: list_brands
tools.description:
List the brands covered by this knowledge base with card counts and a one-line intro
    for each (laser sources, cutting/welding heads, control systems).

tools.name: get_brand_overview
tools.description:
Read a category-level overview essay. Topics: anatomy (what a fiber laser machine is
    made of), laser-sources, cutting-heads, welding-heads, control-systems, cladding-cleaning.
    Written in Chinese; translate for the user as needed.

tools.name: submit_inquiry
tools.description:
Send an inquiry to FerroLaser's sales engineers — for fiber laser machine quotes,
    part/component sourcing, or technical consultation. A human engineer replies within one
    business day. Requires name, a valid email, and a message describing the need.
